title: QoS voice classification and DSCP marking
summary: Classify UDP voice traffic, mark it EF, and attach the policy at the edge.
brief: Create VOICE-ACL to match UDP traffic, use it in class map VOICE, then create policy EDGE-QOS to set DSCP 46 for that class. Apply EDGE-QOS as an input policy on Ethernet1 and verify it. This lab grades configured classification, marking, and attachment only; it does not simulate queues, counters, congestion, policing, shaping, or traffic behavior.
objectives: Classify it with class map VOICE
Mark the class with DSCP 46 in EDGE-QOS
hints: Create the ACL before the class map.
A class map can match the ACL by name.
Set DSCP 46 under the VOICE class, then attach the policy on Ethernet1 input.

process_checks.label: Verified QoS policy classification and marking

checks.label: EDGE-QOS is attached input on Ethernet1
